title: Shiden Kanzaki Launches Black Bullet Reboot Project, New Original Work
content:
Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint announced on Wednesday that Shiden Kanzaki 's Black Bullet light novel series will have a reboot with new content, as well as a completely new story. The reboot project, titled Black Bullet : New World Order , will release two novel volumes every month from November 2026 to February 2027. The volumes from November to December 2026 will contain the same story as the original novel series with some additions and edits, but starting from the volumes in January 2027, the story will diverge from the original, with the volumes releasing in February 2027 ultimately having a different ending.

The re-released novel series will have the same title as the previous novel series, and only diverges slightly in one volume. The final volume will have a completely new title. The title listing of the release dates below uses the English titles of the Yen Press release of the volumes, except in the slightly new divergent title and the new title. The release schedule of the rebooted volumes are as follows:

• November 2026: Black Bullet: New World Order 01 - Those Who Would Be Gods, and Black Bullet: New World Order 02 - Against a Perfect Sniper

• December 2026: Black Bullet: New World Order 03 Book 1 - The Destruction of the World by Fire, and Black Bulllet: New World Order 03 Book 2 - Vengeance is Mine

• January 2027: Black Bullet: New World Order 04 Book 1 - Tōbōhanshi, Satomi Rentarō (slightly different from original Japanese title of volume 5: Tōbōhan, Satomi Rentarō, Yen Press English title: Rentaro Satomi, Fugitive) and Black Bullet: New World Order 04 Book 2 - Purgatory Strider

• February 2027: Black Bullet: New World Order 05 Book 1 - The Bullet That Changed the World, and Black Bullet: New World Order 05 Book 2 - Justice & Unjustice (latter is a completely new title, and did not exist in the original novel run)

In addition, Kanzaki will launch an original work titled Aku no Shinzui (The Quintessence of Evil) under Dengeki Bunko in spring 2027. Dengeki Bunko will announce the new work's illustratior and other details later.

Kanzaki published the original seven-volume light novel series Black Bullet under Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint from July 2011 to April 2014. Saki Ukai illustrated the series. Yen Press released all seven volumes in English.

Hon Morino serialized a manga adaptation of the novel series in Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine from August 2012 to June 2014. Kadokawa published four compiled book volumes for the manga. Yen Press also released all volumes of the manga in English.

The novel series inspired a television anime that premiered in April 2014, just as the novel series was ending. Kinema Citrus and Orange animated the television series. The anime streamed on Crunchyroll , and Sentai Filmworks licensed the series.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Anime World Tour Part 2 Heads to Africa and Australia With Episode 1 Preview
content:
KAGURABACHI anime has revealed details for Part 2 of its ongoing Anime World Tour, with the first 20 minutes of Episode 1 set to screen at upcoming conventions in Johannesburg and Melbourne.

The next stops will take place at Comic Con Africa in Johannesburg and PAX Aus in Melbourne. Both events will feature the 20-minute Episode 1 preview alongside a special appearance by anime producer Kenta Suzuki.

The Comic Con Africa screening is listed for September 27, 2026 from 1:00 to 1:30 p.m. SAST at the Johannesburg Expo Centre’s Anime Cinema. The PAX Aus screening will follow on October 11 from 10:30 to 11:30 a.m. AEDT at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre’s Quokka Theater.

ALSO READ: Kagurabachi Author Takeru Hokazono Draws Sukuna From Jujutsu Kaisen

Part 1 of the Anime World Tour began at Anime Expo in Los Angeles in July before continuing at Japan Expo in Paris, AnimagiC in Mannheim, Otakon in Washington, D.C., and Anime NYC. With the newly announced stops, the campaign will have reached five continents.

Additional details for Anime World Tour Part 3 and the tour’s final event in Japan will be announced this fall.

Kagurabachi , written and illustrated by Takeru Hokazono, is serialized in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump . The highly anticipated anime adaptation is set to premiere in April 2027, with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide (excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea).

Studio Cypic is in charge of the animation production, with Tetsuya Takeuchi as the director. Takeuchi is famously known for the Rock Lee vs Gaara fight in Naruto. We previously also had the chance to interview CyberAgent’s Takahiro Yamauchi , who talked about the company and its goal of creating “ high-quality Japanese animation works that can be accepted globally .”

title: 'Black Bullet' Light Novel Relaunches After 12 Years
content:
Publishing company Kadokawa announced on Wednesday that Shiden Kanzaki 's action sci-fi light novel Black Bullet is relaunching following a 12-year hiatus.

The reboot, titled Black Bullet: New World Order , will be a revised and expanded version of the original light novel. The story will cover the events of the first six original volumes through the New World Order 's fourth volume, before continuing into a completely new arc in the fifth volume, which will be a fully rewritten version of the original seventh volume. The relaunch will be published over four consecutive months beginning in November 2026, with two volumes released simultaneously each month.

Kadokawa's Dengeki Bunko label also released a promotional video for the reboot featuring voice actors Yuuki Kaji and Rina Hidaka reprising their roles as Rentarou Satomi and Enju Aihara, respectively.

Kanzaki originally began publishing Black Bullet under the Dengeki Bunko label with illustrations by Saki Ukai in July 2011. Kadokawa published the seventh and latest volume released in April 2014.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in English and published all seven volumes from August 2015 to September 2017.

A manga adaptation illustrated by Morinohon ran in Dengeki Maoh magazine from in August 2012 to June 2014. Yen Press also licensed and released the manga in English.

Kinema Citrus and Orange adapted the light novel into a 13-episode television anime in Spring 2014. Crunchyroll simulcasted the anime with subtitles. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime in North America and released it on home video in September 2015.

Kanzaki's new light novel, Aku no Shinzui , is scheduled for release in Spring 2027.

title: Manga 'Kin to Tetsu' Concludes Serialization
content:
Ayaka Katayama 's Kin to Tetsu ( Fungus and Iron ) has concluded with its 105th chapter in the October 2026 issue of Bessatsu Shounen Magazine on Tuesday, marking the end of the series' five-year serialization.

Katayama began drawing the dystopian sci-fi suspense manga in Bessatsu Shounen Magazine in March 2021. Kodansha published the ninth volume on April 9, with the tenth and final volume set to be released on October 8.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga for digital release in English in January 2022 and published the ninth e-book volume on July 21.

Katayama made her debut in 2007 after her one-shot Oni Oi no Kawa was selected for the 78th Shounen Magazine Newcomer Manga Awards. The following year, she won the Grand Prize at Shueisha's inaugural Golden Tiara Award for her sci-fi romcom manga Star Man .

Production company VAP announced a television anime adaptation of the series on March 4.

Synopsis Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Opening Song, October 6 Debut
content:
The website for the television anime of Gyōmuyōmochi 's manga adaptation of Asa Rokushima 's Tsuihō Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimamana Second Life o Ōka Suru. ( The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a New Life or Chi-Fuyo for short) novels unveiled the main promotional video and main visual for the anime on Wednesday. The video announces more cast members, the opening theme song "Ember Torch" by the rock band sumika , and the October 6 premiere date for the anime.

The new cast members include:

Takumi Yamazaki as Donguri and Donguri (Real)

Taiten Kusunoki as Balius

Megumi Toyoguchi as Glenda

The anime will premiere on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on October 6 at 24:00 (effectively, October 7 at midnight), and on AT-X on October 8. Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs in Japan.

Shochiku describes the anime:

Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points! With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer! In a world where magic and science intertwine, wild humor meets layered character drama, fueling nonstop fan theories and generating major buzz long before the anime was even announced.

The anime will star:

• Daiki Yamashita as Rein Garland

• Lynn as Lily Flambert

• Yoshino Aoyama as Margaret Ells

• Miyu Tomita as Mirabelle

• Megumi Han as Elsie Zra

• Konomi Kohara as Nina

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Hanbun (Half)

• Makoto Furukawa as Cornelius

• Rie Shibata as Mother of Assassins

Shū Honma ( Ya Boy Kongming! , Mayonaka Punch , Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 "Sisters") is directing the anime at P.A. Works . Yōko Yonaiyama ( Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk , mono, Ya Boy Kongming! ) is in charge of the series scripts. Tadahito Kiyosawa is designing the characters, with Masami Gohda as the sub-character designer. Both Kiyosawa and Gohda also serve as chief animation directors.

Other staff members include:

Rokushima began serializing the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in January 2021, and is still updating the story. Kodansha published the first print volume of the novels with illustrations by kisui in January 2022, and the second volume shipped in October 2022.

Gyōmuyōmochi launched the manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Shōnen Magazine R in November 2021, and moved the manga to Kodansha 's Comic Days app in March 2023 after Shōnen Magazine R ended publication. Kodansha released the manga's 21st compiled book volume on August 7. Kodansha 's K MANGA service is releasing the manga digitally in English.

title: 'Cheat Fuyo' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Asa Rokushima 's Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu? ( The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a New Life: I Can Add "Enhancement Points" Not Just to Weapons but to Anything, and I Can Cancel the Effects Whenever I Want, but Are the People Left Behind Going to Be Okay? ) manga unveiled additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 7 at 12:00 a.m. on TV Tokyo, followed by AT-X.

Cast Donguri: Takumi Yamazaki ( Tamako Market ) Valios: Taiten Kusunoki ( Tennis no Oujisama ) Glenda: Megumi Toyoguchi ( Danganronpa )

Rock band sumika ( Wotaku ni Koi wa Muzukashii ) is performing the opening theme "Ember Torch," which previewed in the first promotional video below.

Shuu Honma ( Mayonaka Punch ) is directing the anime at P.A. Works , with Youko Yonaiyama ( Yubisaki to Renren ) handling the series composition. Yuito Kiyosawa ( Mikadono Sanshimai wa Angai, Choroi. sub-character design) is designing the characters. Alisa Okehazama ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) is composing the music.

Rokushima began penning the adventure fantasy story on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in January 2021. Youmochi Gyoumu began serializing the manga in Shounen Magazine R in October that year and transferred it to Getsumaga Kichi web manga portal in March 2023 following the former's discontinuation. Kodansha published the 21th volume on August 7.

Kodansha began publishing the light novel adaptation under its K Ranobe Book label with illustrations by kisui in January 2022. The second volume went on sale in October 2022.

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Reveals Main Trailer, New Visual, Cast, October 6 Premiere
content:
The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life anime revealed the main trailer and new visual, along with more cast and an October 6, 2026 premiere. The anime previously revealed an action trailer last month.

Animated by P.A.WORKS, the fantasy series follows Rein Garland, an enchantment mage who is expelled from his guild despite spending years strengthening their equipment. As it goes, after reclaiming every enhancement he had placed on his former comrades’ gear, Rein sets off on a new adventure and discovers the true potential of his abilities.

Three additional cast members were announced:

• Takumi Yamazaki as Donguri, Margaret’s pet dog

• Taiten Kusunoki as Barios, the guild master of the Fangs of the King Beast who expels Rain

• Megumi Toyoguchi as Glenda, the guild’s vice master

The previously revealed voice cast for the anime includes:

• Daiki Yamashita as Rein Garland, the protagonist

• Lynn as Lily Flambert, S-rank adventurer

• Yoshino Aoyama as Margaret Els

• Miyu Tomita as Mirabelle

• Megumi Han as Elsie Sora

• Konomi Kohara as Nina

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Hanbun

• Makoto Furukawa as Cornelius

• Rie Shibata as the Mother of Assassins

The anime is directed by Shu Honma at P.A.WORKS. Series composition is handled by Yoko Yonaiyama, while Tadahito Kiyosawa will serve as the character designer and co-chief animation director alongside Masami Gohda, who also handles gag and sub-character designs. You can watch the new trailer below.

The anime will adapt the manga version illustrated by Gyomuyomochi, which is significantly different from Rokushima’s original light novels. K-Manga has the manga available in English, describing the story:

Rein the Enchanter is a support mage with the ability to enhance weapons and armor. But when he gets fired from his guild for the simple reason that he’s already enchanted everything they own, he decides to take the power back into his own hands—literally! Rein recalls every enchantment he ever put on his guildmates’ gear, retrieving the bonus points for himself. But does he really not have anything better to enchant with them than some Plain Clothes and a Copper Sword…? Come along on a cheat-tier journey from the most common of common origins!

Studio P.A. WORKS’ recent anime adaptations include Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze and Skip and Loafer , while some of their recent original works include Mayonaka Punch , Food for the Soul , and last season’s Dusk Beyond the End of the World . The studio’s founder, Kenji Horikawa, also spoke about the difficulties of creating original works as compared to adaptations, saying “ But, if the current situation continues, I feel a sense of crisis that even if we all want to, we might forget how to make an original work. “

Tsuiho Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life o Oka Suru , commonly called Chii Fuyo , is a Japanese web novel by Asa Rokushima that started on Shosetsuka ni Naro in January 2021. Kodansha later released two light novel volumes with illustrations by Kisui in 2022. The manga version by Mochi Gyomuyo began in Shonen Magazine R in October 2021, moved to Monthly Maga Kichi in February 2023, and is also available on Comic Days and Magazine Pocket.

WORKS’ recent anime adaptations include Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze and Skip and Loafer , while some of their recent original works include Mayonaka Punch , Food for the Soul , and last season’s Dusk Beyond the End of the World . The studio’s founder, Kenji Horikawa, also spoke about the difficulties of creating original works as compared to adaptations, saying “ But, if the current situation continues, I feel a sense of crisis that even if we all want to, we might forget how to make an original work. “

Tsuiho Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life o Oka Suru , commonly called Chii Fuyo , is a Japanese web novel by Asa Rokushima that started on Shosetsuka ni Naro in January 2021. Kodansha later released two light novel volumes with illustrations by Kisui in 2022. The manga version by Mochi Gyomuyo began in Shonen Magazine R in October 2021, moved to Monthly Maga Kichi in February 2023, and is also available on Comic Days and Magazine Pocket.

title: Netflix Reveals Its First Look At Fall 2026 Anime Schedule
content:
Summer 2026 has been an exciting season for anime fans with the return of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War and Saga of Tanya the Evil . Along with the major sequels, the latest season also introduced fans to some major hits such as Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia and Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You. However, now that September 2026 is finally here, fans are getting ready to bid farewell to the ongoing seasons. Most of the anime series will conclude this month before paving the way for the Fall 2026 season. Since it’s the final quarter of the year, the Fall 2026 anime lineup looks more exciting than ever. Series such as Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and more return with their highly anticipated sequels.

However, most of the new series will premiere on Crunchyroll before making their way to the Netflix library some time later. Every quarter, Crunchyroll releases dozens of new series for fans across several regions. Compared to that, Netflix usually releases a monthly schedule with fewer but exciting shows and films. October is the first month of the Fall 2026 anime season, which is why the Netflix schedule will be more exciting than ever. What’s on Netflix shared the first look at the Fall 2026 lineup, including the new and ongoing anime.

Netflix Will Premiere New Anime in October 2026

Since it’s only September, there’s still a chance the platform will confirm new additions for the Fall 2026 lineup. So far, Blue Box Season 2, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2, and My Happy Marriage special episodes have been confirmed for October 2026. Fans have been anticipating a Blue Box sequel for two years now, and it will be streaming exclusively on Netflix starting October 4th, 2026. Compared to that, the wait for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners sequel was even longer since the first season was released in 2022. Unlike Blue Box , this sci-fi action will drop all of its episodes together on October 20th, 2026.

Lastly, My Happy Marriage still hasn’t shared any updates for its Season 3, but these special episodes are more than enough to keep fans intrigued in the meantime. All three special episodes will land on the platform on October 25th, 2026, so don’t forget to mark your calendars. Additionally, the platform will continue streaming the weekly episodes of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Stage 2 after a massive backlash from fans in March this year. The anime released a 47-minute special episode without confirming a release date for Stage 2, which sparked outrage among fans.

Many were worried that the platform would drop new episodes in the same pattern, but luckily that wasn’t the case at all. Lastly, Netflix will also continue streaming new weekly episodes of Daemons of the Shadow Realm and One Piece ‘s Elbaph Arc. The October 2026 schedule is already exciting enough, and there’s still a chance more series will be added later on. Additionally, we can also expect Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and more Fall 2026 anime shows to be added to Netflix, but those will be limited to select regions in Asia.

title: Live-Action Anata o Korosu Tabi BL Series Gets 2nd Season
content:
Fuji TV announced on Tuesday that it is producing a second season for the live-action series of Sai Asai 's Anata o Korosu Tabi (A Journey to Kill You) boys' love manga that will premiere on Fuji TV On Demand on October 8.

Masanari Wada (right in visual above) as Kinji Kataoka, and Hiroto Takahashi (left) stars as Ren Odajima. Both return from the first season. Other returning cast members include Shintarō Yūya as Keito Dōi, Keisuke Teranaka as Genichirō Kumakura, Tōi Nakabayashi as Eiji Ichinose, and Shunsaku Kudō as Seizō Dōi.

The new cast members include:

• Ryōka Minamide as Kazuki Matsuyama, the cheerful new hire of the Kirii yakuza group

• Tomohisa Yuge as Ryūya Motoki, the leader of the organized crime group Void

• Ren Yagami as Yoshio Kataoka, Kinji's father

• Hiroki Matsumoto as Kao Hikari, the leader and strongman of the Mitsunori-kai, Kanto's strongest yakuza group

• Yoshihiko Hakamada as Ryō Ibashi, Kao's lieutenant

Daisuke Kamijō (live-action I Hear the Sunspot ) is again directing the second season. Returning scriptwriter Natsuko Takahashi is joined by Jun Narita . Masaki Takao is once again composing the music.

The yakuza crime BL manga centers on Kataoka, a young lieutenant in a yakuza group, and his underling Odajima. When Kataoka does something drastic that puts the heat on him, the group tells him to take a trip and let things cool down, with Odajima trusted to take care of him. Odajima does everything for Kataoka, from groceries to sex. But Odajima is also trusted with another grim task: to kill Kataoka.

The first season premiered on Fuji TV On Demand in September 2025.

Akita Shoten published the manga in one compiled book volume in February 2020. Akita Shoten also re-released the manga in two volumes, which shipped in February and September 2025.

Seven Seas Entertainment previously published Asai's Alice in the Country of Clover: Knight's Knowledge and Alice in Twin World: Love, Storms, and Flower Clocks manga, which are part of the larger Alice in the Country of Hearts franchise that originated as otome visual novel games.

title: 'She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man' Manga to End in Volume 16
content:
The publisher Micro Magazine and online retailers are listing the 16th volume of Dicca Suemitsu 's manga adaptation of Hirotsugu Ryusen 's She professed herself pupil of the wise man. ( Kenja no Deshi o Nanoru Kenja ) light novels as the final volume. The volume will ship on October 29.

Seven Seas licensed both the light novel and the manga, and it describes the story:

Sakamori Kagami was one of the top players in the VRMMO Ark Earth Online as Danblf, a veteran summoner with the gravitas to match his elite status. When he falls asleep playing one day, he's transported to a world where the game is reality—but instead of his all-powerful avatar, he's stuck in the body of a cute young girl! He can't let anyone know that this little cutie is really Danblf, so he takes the name “Mira” and claims to be Danblf's disciple. If this gets out, he'll never live it down!

Ryusen began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in April 2012. Micro Magazine is publishing the story in print with illustrations by Fuzichoco ( The 8th son? Are you kidding me? , R.O.D Rehabilitation art), beginning with the first print volume in June 2014.

Suemitsu launched the manga adaptation on Micro Magazine 's Comic Ride manga website in July 2016.

The television anime aired in January 2022. Funimation is exclusively streaming the series, and is also streaming an English dub .
